name: Jelly QoL
description: Quality-of-life features for Jellyfin 12.1: live active-filter warnings and optional animations, plus movie/series visibility, user groups and independent reveal schedules. English and Polish.
overview: Live filter warnings and Media Hider controls in two settings tabs.

versions.changelog: Renamed to Jelly QoL. Added live active-filter warnings for Jellyfin 12.1, optional animation, separate Media Hider and QoL tabs, and a simple text-only thumbnail. Existing visibility settings, groups and schedules are preserved.

Optional user groups, independent one-time reveal date and time for each group, administrator-only fallback without groups, simple catalog thumbnail, and in-memory File Transformation integration. Existing title settings are preserved.
